s.zh: （超过后成长为四分之一，升级费用继续提高）
s.en: (beyond it growth is a quarter, and upgrade costs keep rising)

s.zh: 降低上限不删除已有经验；等级收益按当前设置截断。恢复上限后恢复原有成长。
s.en: Lowering the cap doesn't delete existing XP; level benefits are truncated by the current setting. Raising the cap again restores original growth.

s.zh: 死去的巨魔若死前6小时内没受火焰或酸液伤害、大脑完好，尸体保持新鲜约1天后原地复活。对敌方巨魔同样有效。
s.en: A dead troll that took no fire or acid damage in the 6 hours before death and whose brain is intact keeps a fresh corpse and revives in place after about 1 day. Works on enemy trolls too.

s.zh: 每个巨魔一生最多复活：
s.en: Max revivals per troll per lifetime:

s.zh: 巨躯规则：体型影响生命与近战
s.en: Giant frame rule: body size affects health and melee

s.zh: 火巨人、巨魔、牛头人体型越大，生命总量和近战伤害越高：生命×(1+0.5×强度×(体型倍率−1))，近战×(1+0.3×强度×(体型倍率−1))。成年火巨人的生命不低于×150%（与体型倍率取较大值），所以强度只会提高、不会降低它们的生命；火巨人儿童随年龄增长。死灵造物不适用，小体型不减。关闭（或强度0%）时没有近战加成，火巨人的生命为旧的×150%（取较大值）。
s.en: Fire giants, trolls and minotaurs have more total health and melee damage the larger their body size: health ×(1 + 0.5 × strength × (size multiplier − 1)), melee ×(1 + 0.3 × strength × (size multiplier − 1)). Adult fire giants have health no lower than ×150% (the larger of this and the size multiplier), so strength only raises their health, never lowers it; fire giant children grow with age. Doesn't apply to necromantic constructs, and small sizes aren't reduced. When off (or strength 0%), no melee bonus, and fire giant health is the old ×150% (the larger value).
% (scales both the health and melee factors)

s.zh: 脑髓归零的夺心魔每小时有15%概率陷入狂乱。关闭后只有虚弱和负面心情。
s.en: A mind flayer whose brain matter hits zero has a 15% chance per hour to go into a frenzy. When off, only weakness and a negative mood.

s.zh: 天（被寄生者完全化形为夺心魔所需的基础天数）
s.en: days (base days needed for the host to fully transform into a mind flayer)

s.zh: 3级及以上的上古脑每隔一段时间用心灵呼唤一个流浪者：对方会恍惚地走到上古脑旁边倒下。默认关闭。
s.en: Elder brains of level 3 and above periodically call a wanderer psychically: they walk in a daze to the elder brain and collapse beside it. Off by default.

s.zh: 的命匣已毁：无法再通过此命匣复生。
s.en: 's phylactery is destroyed: revival through this phylactery is no longer possible.

s.zh: 此超凡基因提供巫妖仪式资格与潜能。建造死灵仪式台，由此角色执行巫妖仪式，才能建立命匣与不死之身。原有内源和异种基因均保留。
s.en: This archite gene grants eligibility and potential for the lich ritual. Build a necromantic ritual table and have this character perform the lich ritual to establish a phylactery and undying body. Existing endogenes and xenogenes are all kept.

s.zh: 在死灵仪式台添加巫妖仪式工作单，并把执行者限制为此角色。
s.en: Add a lich ritual bill at the necromantic ritual table and restrict the worker to this character.

s.zh: 命匣失联：修复、施法与造物统御暂停。
s.en: Phylactery link lost: repair, casting and construct command paused.

s.zh: 伤口修复量与断肢重塑速度按心灵敏感度线性提升。100%时每250刻修复1点伤害、消耗0.5点精神力；每个缺失部位需一天与60点精神力。200%时效果翻倍，完成同样修复的总消耗减半。优先较重伤口，治好后剩余治疗量继续用于其他伤口；按实际总治疗量扣费。精神力不足或心灵敏感度为0时暂停。当前倍率：
s.en: Wound repair amount and limb regrowth speed scale linearly with psychic sensitivity. At 100%, 1 damage is repaired per 250 ticks for 0.5 psyfocus; each missing part takes one day and 60 psyfocus. At 200% the effect doubles and the total cost of the same repair halves. Worse wounds go first, and leftover healing continues on other wounds; cost is by actual total healing. Pauses when psyfocus runs out or psychic sensitivity is 0. Current multiplier:

s.zh: 仅强化主要器官和肢体：头部、躯干、脊椎、手臂、腿、大脑、心脏、肺、肝、肾、胃、眼睛和耳朵。每层+20%该部位生命上限、+12%部位效率，占用5点精神力上限；立即消耗5点精神力与2心灵熵。每部位最多5层。
s.en: Only reinforces major organs and limbs: head, torso, spine, arms, legs, brain, heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, stomach, eyes and ears. Each layer: +20% part max health, +12% part efficiency, uses 5 points of psyfocus cap; immediately costs 5 psyfocus and 2 neural heat. At most 5 layers per part.

s.zh: 精神力、心灵熵空间或可用上限不足，或部位已满5层。
s.en: Not enough psyfocus, neural heat room or available cap, or the part already has 5 layers.

s.zh: 选择一个部位解除全部强化，恢复原生命上限并释放精神力上限；不返还精神力。重伤超过原生命上限时，须先修复才能解除。
s.en: Choose a part to remove all its reinforcement, restoring the original max health and freeing psyfocus cap; psyfocus isn't refunded. If an injury exceeds the original max health, it must be repaired before removal.

s.zh: 此部位伤势过重，请先修复，再解除强化。
s.en: This part is too badly hurt; repair it first, then remove the reinforcement.
